image_description: A close-up, sepia-toned image featuring two audio cassette tapes. One cassette is positioned in the upper background, lying flat, showing its label side with visible text and spools. The second cassette is in the lower-left foreground, angled to show the tape window and one spool clearly. The image has a shallow depth of field, with the background cassette slightly out of focus compared to the foreground elements.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight warping or softness along the right edge suggests minor perspective inconsistency or blending artifacts, though not structurally catastrophic.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette tape and not a similar rectangular object.
To verify the physical continuity of the plastic shell and ensure no floating parts or merging errors between the two cassettes.
To assess the spatial relationship between the two cassettes and ensure the depth of field and shadows are physically consistent.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the label, checking for severe gibberish or character fusion.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the cassette shell (corners and edges)
Symmetry and mechanical plausibility of the internal spools
Legibility and realism of the label text
Boundary separation between the two overlapping cassettes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the mechanical symmetry of the spool hubs. AI often generates 'melted' or asymmetrical gears/hubs. Also, verify if the text on the label is merely blurry or actually nonsensical/gibberish, as this impacts the artifact score. Ensure the transparency effects on the plastic casing are physically consistent with light refraction.
